adjudication.rationale: Looking at parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts lines 14-18, the condition `if (APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT)` determines which schema to use. Looking at refreshOAuthTokens.ts lines 4-6, when userId is null (team credentials), it falls back to calling refreshFunction() directly. However, parseRefreshTokenResponse is called separately after refreshOAuthTokens returns, and it doesn't know whether the refresh was done via sync endpoint or provider. So when APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED is true but userId was null (causing provider fallback), parseRefreshTokenResponse still uses minimumTokenResponseSchema instead of the provider-specific schema. This is a real logic bug where the schema selection doesn't account for the fallback case.
